config.capture: 54 input tokens + 7 decode steps; CUDA trace, no per-op CUDA sync

counter_limit: ncu ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM; bandwidth is useful tensor bytes / measured duration, not hardware DRAM throughput or utilization counters
phase_sampling_note: 328 intact decode records per version; exclude buffered warmup records and one stdout-interleaved record. Each phase includes its scheduling overhead.

speed_before.method: single process; concurrency 1; direct runtime token fetch; no logits or trace; greedy; timings exclude model load; prefix cache disabled

speed_after.method: single process; concurrency 1; direct runtime token fetch; no logits or trace; greedy; timings exclude model load; prefix cache disabled

validation.build: bash install.sh successful; installed library SHA256 matches build
validation.cpu: FP16 values within normalized FP8 range; FP8 midpoint/subnormal/sign/RTZ; partial blocks; random tiled GEMM versus FP64; MoE versus scalar BF16/FP8 oracle; AVX512 and AVX2 paths
validation.cuda: RoPE; GQA; sink; sliding-window limits; fused size boundary 256/257; sparse attention; stable indexer; standalone racecheck and memcheck
